title: DSH plugin declaration
description: Draft plugin declaration protocol. Validating a declaration describes author intent only; it is not host acceptance, loading or execution evidence. No JSON Schema engine is bundled: normative validation is performed by validateDeclaration() in this package.
$comment: protocolVersion: 0.1.0-draft.1 | Generated from src/index.js declarationJsonSchema(); edit that function, not this file. | Not expressible in JSON Schema, and therefore not enforced by a schema-only validator: repeated object field names in the JSON text (no single-keyword constraint exists; only a JSON-text parser can see them); capabilities.required and capabilities.optional must be disjoint (uniqueItems is per array; cross-array disjointness has no keyword).

schemaVersion.description: Must equal "0.1.0-draft.1". No other revision is accepted.

id.description: Opaque non-empty plugin identifier without leading or trailing whitespace.

version.description: Opaque non-empty version label. No SemVer parsing, ordering or satisfiability is defined by this protocol.

items.description: Capability the plugin declares as required.

required.description: Must be disjoint from capabilities.optional. Disjointness is NOT expressible in JSON Schema (uniqueItems covers one array at a time), so a schema-only check does not enforce it.

items.description: Capability the plugin declares as optional.

optional.description: Must be disjoint from capabilities.required. Disjointness is NOT expressible in JSON Schema (uniqueItems covers one array at a time), so a schema-only check does not enforce it.

resources.description: Required array of resource claims; it may be empty. It is never defaulted, and null is not accepted. No two entries may share the same (kind, name, scope) triple: each entry has exactly these three required fields, so duplicate triples are equal items and uniqueItems rejects them at the schema level as well.

kind.description: Resource category. Not a host registration API.

name.description: Opaque non-empty resource name without leading or trailing whitespace.

scope.description: Author-supplied static label: any non-empty string without leading or trailing whitespace. Not a host, agent or session scope, and no default is applied.

path.description: Empty string for the declaration root; otherwise a dot/bracket path.
